## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak overall breadth plus narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 of top performers from Technology) and a MAJOR divergence between large-cap software winners and semiconductor/hardware losers.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows selective leadership: META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -13.13% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -3.29%) BELOW TREND. Industrials/Materials showing weakness: CAT (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -8.35%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -7.29% | 1M: +2.95%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in semicap/hardware and select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: PANW (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR Divergence evident (several large names showing 1W vs 1M sign flips) — treat moves as tactical opportunity, not core position.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed / internal rotation: META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND. Sector tone: selective leadership, not broad tech risk-on.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft overall: JPM (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.30%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: weak; style mixed between payments resilience and bank pressure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure: AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -13.13% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: weak with headline-driven swings.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective Energy and large-cap Tech winners (XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to semicap/hardware weakness (NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by price; META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND — momentum. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum; SHOP (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND — continued downside risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy — XOM/OXY/CVX confirming strength and likely continue to lead if oil steadies. BEARISH: Healthcare and Materials/Industrials — multiple names showing weekly breakdowns and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA weekly lows for confirmation of sustained BELOW TREND pressure; a reclaim of that zone would be needed to argue stabilization. Monitor AAPL and META holding recent weekly gains to sustain ABOVE TREND status, and XOM/OXY continuation above recent highs to confirm Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
QCOM (+65): news on Amazon AI chip deal, price confirming — QCOM (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND (sentiment confirmed). BA (+60): defense contract bullish but price is below recent trend — BA (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND (sentiment diverging). LRCX (+60): upbeat WFE outlook but price is sharply down — LRCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND (distribution signal).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMGN (-45): negative headlines align with price — AMGN (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed). BKNG (-45): regulatory/growth headwinds and price weakness — BKNG (1W: -9.06% | 1M: -17.61%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed). GOOGL (-40): negative chatter but price remains ABOVE TREND — GOOGL (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND (sentiment diverging; watch for follow-through).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. META (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence between tech winners and semicap/hardware losers (NVDA, LRCX, ASML) with several bullish headlines not yet reflected in price — monitor sentiment vs price for confirmation.
